reason: A bounded MCP adapter for DeepSeek Harness that searches and collects posts, videos, creator feeds, and optionally comments from supported social platforms through MediaCrawler, with supervised runs and durable exports.

summaries.zh: 通过 MediaCrawler 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供受监督的社交平台搜索、内容采集、运行管理和结果导出能力。
summaries.en: A supervised MCP adapter that lets DeepSeek Harness search supported social platforms, collect content through MediaCrawler, manage runs, and export results.

capabilities: Browser-based collection from supported social platforms
Durable run, log, artifact, and export storage
Crawler process start and stop control
Deletion and retention cleanup of completed runs
Collection and export of potentially personal data
